'''''Javelin''''' was a group of 4 [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
The corvettes, along with multiple [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]], were part of an [[Battle of Roche (Galactic Civil War)|operation]] to capture a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] prototype of [[Shantipole Project]]. While the first prototype was unarmed, the second was and was able to provide cover for the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] corvette [[Shantipole (CR90 corvette)|''Shantipole'']] and the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Falcon (Lambda-class)|''Falcon'']] which would pick up [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]. The prototype, along with some [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] managed to destroy all of the corvettes and transports, allowing the ''Shantipole'' to escape. The event was recorded and recreated to train future [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]].
